P.name: Fired Up!
P.title: Template:Data Milio/Fired Up!
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Fired Up!|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Milio
|skill        = I
|icon         = Fired Up!.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Milio's''' {{tip|ability}} hits on himself and allied {{tip|champions}} grant an enchantment for 4 seconds, which causes the next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--not on-hit--> or ability hit against enemies to deal {{as|{{pp|7;11;15|1;6;9|key=%}} of enchanted target's AD}} {{ccs|{{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}|magic}} and apply a burn that deals{{ft|{{as|{{pplevel|10 to 50}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 20% of '''Milio's''' AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}|{{as|{{pplevel|10/6 to 50/6|round=2}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|20/6|round=2}}% of '''Milio's''' AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds}}over {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Allies, Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = Special
|spelleffects = default
|parry        = Unknown
|notes        = 
* Both the burst and the burn respect {{tip|enchantment redirection}}.
* When the damage is triggered by allies, it is additionally tagged as {{tip|proc damage}}.
* Subsequent applications of ''Fired Up!'' only refresh the duration.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will not block the effect if applied by a basic attack.
* {{pft}} ''Fired Up's'' interaction with parry effects ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}} and {{tip|blind}}).
<!--Blurb-->
|blurb       = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Milio}} abilities enchant allied {{tip|champions}} on-contact, causing their next basic attack or ability hit shortly after to apply a {{ccs|burst|magic}} and then a short burn to the target enemy, both parts dealing {{as|magic damage}}.
}}

Q.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
Q.title: Template:Data Milio/Ultra Mega Fire Kick
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Ultra Mega Fire Kick|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Milio
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Ultra Mega Fire Kick.png
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} After a {{fd|0.25}}-second delay, '''Milio''' kicks a fireball in the target direction that grants {{tip|sight}} of its path and {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} the first enemy it hits over 1 second.
|description2 = Upon collision, the ball bounces once in the {{tt|same|parallel to original cast direction}} direction from the target's location, granting sight of the area before exploding in the same radius after a brief delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
|leveling2    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 320}} {{as|(+ 120% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|40 to 60}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}}}}
|description3 = If the primary target is a non-champion, the ball knocks back further and creates a larger explosion. ''Ultra Mega Fire Kick'' refunds 50% of its {{sti|{{as|mana cost}}}} if it hits at least one champion with the fireball or explosion.
|description4 = '''''Milio''' cannot cast other abilities during Ultra Mega Fire Kick's delay.''
|cooldown     = 10
|costtype     = Mana
|cost         = {{ap|50 to 70}}
|cast time    = none
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly=true}} 120
|speed        = 1200
|range        = 1200
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|100|Sight radius of missile}}|{{tip|cr|icononly=true}} {{tt|250|Champion hit reveal and explosion radius}}|{{tt|275|Minion hit reveal and explosion radius}}|{{tt|190|Champion knock back distance}}}}
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = true
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|projectile   = true
|notes        = 
<!--Blurb-->
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Milio}} kicks a fireball in the target direction that briefly {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} the first enemy hit. The ball then bounces once toward the target and explodes, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} enemies hit.
|blurb2       = If the primary target is a non-{{tip|champion}}, the ball knocks back further and creates a larger explosion.
}}
